subject: Workplace Skills
title: Social Loafing in Teams
description: A fast breakdown of Social Loafing in Teams for builders.

hook.text: Max Ringelmann found that people pull a rope with less force in a group than when pulling alone.

buildup.text: Social loafing means individuals reduce effort when their contribution isn't identifiable within a group.

discovery.text: The cure is individual accountability. When each person's output is visible, loafing nearly disappears.

twist.text: Social loafing increases with group size. The larger the team, the easier it is to hide in the crowd.

climax.text: Assign clear ownership for every deliverable. The words 'the team will handle it' guarantee loafing.

punchline.text: Name one owner per task. Loafing hates sunlight.

quiz.question: What is the most effective way to prevent social loafing?
options: Reducing the overall workload for the team
Making each person's individual contribution visible
Adding more team members to share the burden
